note: Known disagreements for validate_collections.py's cross-collection standing check: quotes that carry the same text in several collections under different verificationStatus values, as found on 2026-10-20. Each group's 'text' is the normalized text (normalize_quote_text) and 'quotes' records the copies and the standings they had when the entry was written. This list exists only so CI stays green while the editorial research to settle each group is done; it is not a place to park new disagreements. Settle a group by giving every copy the same verificationStatus, then delete its entry here (the validator fails on an entry whose group now agrees, or has gained a copy). The file may only shrink.
